verifications.notes: The Export action returns all users when the query parameter isAdmin is true, and no [Authorize] or other role check is present in the visible code.
The delete method lacks any @PreAuthorize or other role guard in the visible code, allowing any authenticated user to delete any account.
The route uses only ensureLoggedIn, which only checks authentication; no admin role check is present before the delete operation.
The export route checks only the isAdmin query parameter and does not enforce an admin role guard in the visible code.
The view action performs a SELECT on users by id without any role check; the included auth.php only verifies login, not admin privileges.
